item.title: HSD price increased by Rs3 per litre, petrol price maintained
item.description: The government increased the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs3 per litre and maintained the price of petrol for the next fortnight.

item.title: Rupee stable against dollar as remittances rise
item.description: The rupee held steady against the US dollar as workers' remittances rose compared with a year earlier, State Bank of Pakistan data showed.

item.title: Discos seek quarterly FCA, NEPRA reserves decision
item.description: Power distribution companies sought a fuel charge adjustment for the previous quarter; NEPRA reserved its decision after the hearing.
